title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 153
paragraphs: But as soon as Cyrus had left Sardis, Pactyas persuaded the Lydians to revolt against Tabalos and against Cyrus. He went down to the coast and, since he had all the gold from Sardis, he hired mercenaries and convinced the coastal peoples to join him. Then he marched on Sardis and besieged Tabalos in the citadel.
